findings.text: follow-on: the shadow-pick and the dry-run pick (reckon/cli.py:2251) do not pass the authority the done_when names; they reach it only through the resolution fallback at dispatch.py:5198-5201, which catches CrewError, PlanVisibilityError, OSError, KeyError and TypeError and leaves pick_authority None, so a resolution failure silently re-charges the granted fragment on those two paths.

follow-on: the request estimate is now measured with backend_settings=None while each offered candidate's block renders the per-candidate context-fit estimate contexts[name]["estimated_tokens"] measured with that backend's settings (snapshot.py:305, 532), so the done_when's "same backend-settings rule" holds only where per-backend standing chains coincide, which the manifest's own evidence_inputs concedes as an authority-only divergence in this repository.

item_verdicts.diff: read revision by revision at 63976acb against 8c1fe22; dispatch_picker_selection gains an authority parameter and a resolution fallback, the request estimate drops backend_settings and takes authority, inputs carry authority into pick(), the main call site passes it, a 178-line test file is added and one fragment is corrected.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names three production pick call sites, a new test driving a real dispatch_picker_selection, a corrected evidence fragment and a base/head gate; the main dispatch site passes the authority (dispatch.py:6895) while the shadow-pick (dispatch.py:5304) and dry-run (reckon/cli.py:2251) sites reach it only through the resolution fallback at dispatch.py:5198-5201, and the gate logs record 195 passed base / 196 passed head at EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal asks the production pick to hand the dispatch authority to the picker so Jev weighs one context figure; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6895 passes authority=authority into dispatch_picker_selection and dispatch.py:5213 measures the request estimate with it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records head 63976acb at base 8c1fe22, both gate logs with 0 failures, the red negative-control log, and the flake retired in retry_failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven paths and the diff at 63976acb touches exactly four of them - reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py and the two docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker fragments - with nothing else changed.

justifications.durability: tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py:178 asserts request_estimate == with_authority against an independent direct measurement, and the declared mutation (stop passing the authority at dispatch.py:6895) reddens it at 53821 against 51535.
justifications.evidence: the manifest records gate-base.log (195 passed, EXIT=0, revision 8c1fe22) and gate-head.log (196 passed, EXIT=0, revision 63976acb) and the negative control at negative-control.log reddens test_request_estimate_and_candidate_blocks_are_one_figure at EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: the authority parameter and its resolution fallback follow the existing authority= call sites in dispatch.py:5613-5718 and carry no plan or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: dispatch.py:6912 passes the dispatcher's resolved authority into dispatch_picker_selection and dispatch.py:5213 threads it into both the estimate and pick(), so the production pick no longer leaves the granted fragment charged.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing resolve_dispatch_authority owner (reckon/crew/routing.py:2851) and the picker's existing authority threading rather than adding a parallel mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat over 63976acb lists only reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py and the two evidence fragments, all inside the manifest's seven declared write paths.
